body:
Personal note: the insecticide crew crossed at dawn, leaving yellow dust on the grass. The deer fled, and by afternoon the clover where they had grazed was dull and curled.

I saved it from the rubbish bag because the back lists the plots they treated.

It could be a mistake in the copying. The sprayer tanks stacked beside the page were real enough, and still half full.
title: Notepad page

body: The north trail was marked clear after the patrol turned back halfway. I asked why my brother’s campsite appeared on the completed section. The ranger said the box only had room for one kind of mark.
title: Notepad page
